body: Back to draft: takeover of review items 1-3 (sample grid cap, search work on the face budget, out-of-domain fallback), by the maintainer's word; a push to this branch follows.

Takeover of review items 1-3 (by the maintainer's word), pushed as `d8eb242f4` on top of `d7bbf723`. The PR stays a draft. Items 4-7 of the review are not touched and stay open.

## Item 1: unbounded sample grid

`step_nearest::samples()` now returns nothing when one sample per knot span is already more than `MAX_SAMPLES` (4,096, the bound the code already named). No grid is built and no sample is evaluated. A boundary point of such a face that needs the second search flags the face (`Fault::Grid`), and the import refuses it by name: "face #N (...) could not be tessellated: a boundary point had to be searched for again, and the surface has more knot spans than the search may sample (4096)".

Pinned by `step_guard::tests::a_face_with_more_spans_than_the_search_grid_is_refused_by_name` (a 300 x 300-span sheet, a point 1e-4 off it). On `d7bbf723` it failed: the face was not refused (`tripped()` was `None`), and the one search ran for over 60 s in debug. On the new head it passes within the lib run's 1.5 s.

## Item 2: search work outside the issue-1536 budget

Every second search is charged to the face's meter before it runs: 1 + 4,096 + 8 x 101 = 4,905 evaluations, the most one search can take. Past the cap the face trips and is refused like any runaway, and a face already refused in the pass runs no further search.

Pinned by `step_guard::tests::second_searches_spend_the_face_budget_and_trip_it` (points 1e-4 off a 14-turn flank: one search is counted, 40 of them run a 50,000 budget out). On `d7bbf723` it failed: the meter read 0 after a search. Passes on the new head.

## Item 3: silent fallback

The `_ => found` arm is gone. When no search finds the point inside the knot domain and truck's answer is outside it, the search answers nothing, the face is flagged (`Fault::Outside`) and the import refuses it by name: "... a boundary point lies off the surface, outside its knot domain". An answer inside the domain that no search betters is kept as truck gave it, as on main.

Pinned by `step_guard::tests::a_boundary_point_outside_the_knot_domain_is_refused_not_answered`. On `d7bbf723` it failed: the search returned `Some((1.5, 0.5))` on a [0, 1] domain. Passes on the new head. Two existing unit tests pinned the old fallback and were changed to the refusal: `a_point_off_the_face_keeps_trucks_answer` (now `a_point_off_the_face_is_refused_not_answered_outside_the_domain`) and `a_rescue_never_answers_outside_the_knot_domain`.

The review's side question (`search_parameter` returns on truck's `None` before the second search) is left as it was.

## Decisions taken (the option that refuses more), in `docs/decisions/1602-thread-strip-mesh.md` section 4

- The grid is capped by a refusal, not by striding the knots or keeping truck's unchecked answer.
- An out-of-domain answer refuses the face; it is not logged and kept, and not clamped.
- Both can refuse files that imported before this PR: a dense fitted surface (more than about 64 x 64 spans) whose edge curves lie more than 1e-6 off it, and a face whose boundary runs past its surface's edge by more than a millionth of the knot span. Neither was measured on real files; the bound and the trigger distance are the maintainer's to move.

## Results on `d8eb242f4` (Windows, debug)

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib -- geometry::import`: 65 passed, 1 ignored (the heavy-lane test).
- Run one by one: `import_step_guard` 6, `step_chord_units` 3, `step_budget` 6, `large_models` 3 (1 ignored), `step_nesting` 8, `import_step_corner_blend` 3, `import_step_thread` 1, `step_fidelity` 2. All passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Not exercised

- The two user parts (10208.STEP, 32050.STEP) and sc_logo.step: not on this machine, so their facet counts, times and closed-shell readings were not re-taken with the charge and the two refusals in place.
- A whole-file import that ends in one of the two new refusals: the tests reach them through the metered face and the shell's trip, not through a STEP file.
- The heavy lane (`--release -- --ignored`), the UI import path, Linux and macOS.
- Not merged with current main; no Actions run was started.
